task_instance: Produce a service-mesh observability bundle for a sample Istio-based app (namespace 'shop', services frontend/checkout/payments/inventory/catalog): golden-signal PromQL queries, a Grafana dashboard JSON for traffic/errors/latency/topology, SLO definitions with error-budget math, and Prometheus burn-rate + golden-signal alerting rules.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md (skill's own templates were present). The skill's core deliverable is observability configuration/documentation text, fully within the text-file runtime. Created input sample services.md and four deliverable files in the work directory: golden-signals.promql (traffic/error/latency/saturation/dependency queries using istio_requests_total and istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket, reporter=destination, per the skill's golden-signals section and Template 2), grafana-dashboard.json (dashboard with templating var and 4 panels: request rate, 5xx % gauge thresholds, P50/P99 latency, nodeGraph topology, modeled on Template 5), slo.md (availability and latency SLIs/SLOs per service with 30d error-budget PromQL), prometheus-alerts.yaml (native rule-file format: high error rate, high P99, plus multi-window multi-burn-rate SLO alerts, adapting the skill's Alerting Rules section). Verified by self-review: PromQL selectors/labels are internally consistent across all files, dashboard JSON braces/arrays balance and reference the same metric names, alert thresholds match the stated SLO targets (frontend 99.5%, payments 99.9%). No code execution, binaries, credentials, network, MCP/connector tools, or shell used; wrote files directly to full paths. Used native Prometheus rule-file format to avoid the template's CRD apiVersion placeholders. No deliverable depended on an unreachable placeholder host/url.
